summary: Arrive AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $14,967,247 in common stock. The agreement allows periodic sales under Rule 415, with Maxim receiving a 2.5% commission. The shares are issued under an effective S-3 shelf registration. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation.
